The user wants to set the log level of `svc-beacon-225` to `debug`.
According to the runbook `/runbooks/ops.md`:
1. Read `/workspace/ticket-TCK-758702.txt` (Done).
2. GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-225`.
3. POST `/api/tickets/TCK-758702/token` for an approved token.
4. POST `/api/services/svc-beacon-225/log-level` with level `debug` and the token.
5. Call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-audit-6481`.
6. Submit report.

The next step is to GET `/api/services/svc-beacon-225` to check its current status.
